# Paired statistics on the held-out sets (SIMULATED; generated by tools/paired_stats.py)

Same records for every system in a table, so the gain and its bootstrap interval are paired. Wilson intervals per system. McNemar: exact two-sided test on the discordant pairs. Record exact = all five fields match the scripted gold.

### heldout4_asr (record exact; reference = base; paired on the same records)

| system | n | rate [Wilson 95 %] | gain vs reference, pts [bootstrap 95 %] | sys right / ref wrong | ref right / sys wrong | McNemar p |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| gmaps-parser | 138 | 0.652 [0.570, 0.727] | +39.9 [+31.9, +48.6] | 55 | 0 | 5.6e-17 |
| gold | 138 | 1.000 [0.973, 1.000] | +74.6 [+67.4, +81.9] | 103 | 0 | 2e-31 |
| grammar | 138 | 0.377 [0.300, 0.460] | +12.3 [+2.9, +21.7] | 31 | 14 | 0.016 |
| base (reference) | 138 | 0.254 [0.188, 0.332] | — | — | — | — |
